# Home Automation Stack

Host **automation.lindleyhome.com** — Docker stack (complement to [HA Wall Kiosks](https://oei3894h.sprint.apps.dynatracelabs.com/ui/apps/dynatrace.dashboards/dashboard/46082379-e46e-46e9-a304-7706e309cbf6#from=now()-24h&to=now()) and [Ops Explorer](https://oei3894h.sprint.apps.dynatracelabs.com/ui/apps/dynatrace.dashboards/dashboard/0091f243-4911-4bae-bc3e-77e12ed4f8f8#from=now()-24h&to=now())).

**Containers:** homeassistant · appdaemon · mosquitto · zwavejs2mqtt · ha-mcp · otel-collector.

**Automation:** SRG-HomeAssistant · HASS Updater · container silence detectors.

1.query:
fetch logs
| filter host.name == "automation.lindleyhome.com" and isNotNull(container.name)
| filter in(container.name, {"homeassistant", "appdaemon", "mosquitto", "zwavejs2mqtt", "ha-mcp", "otel-collector"})
| summarize lines = count()
1.title: Container log lines

2.query:
fetch logs
| filter host.name == "automation.lindleyhome.com" and container.name == "homeassistant"
| filter contains(lower(content), "error") or contains(lower(content), "exception")
| summarize errors = count()
2.title: HA error-ish

3.query:
fetch logs
| filter host.name == "automation.lindleyhome.com" and container.name == "appdaemon"
| filter contains(lower(content), "error") or contains(lower(content), "exception")
| summarize errors = count()
3.title: AppDaemon error-ish

4.title: Host CPU %

5.query:
fetch logs
| filter host.name == "automation.lindleyhome.com" and isNotNull(container.name)
| filter in(container.name, {"homeassistant", "appdaemon", "mosquitto", "zwavejs2mqtt", "ha-mcp", "otel-collector", "ops-explorer"})
| summarize lines=count(), by:{container.name}
| sort lines desc
5.title: Log volume by container

6.query:
fetch logs
| filter host.name == "automation.lindleyhome.com" and isNotNull(container.name)
| filter in(container.name, {"homeassistant", "appdaemon", "mosquitto", "zwavejs2mqtt", "ha-mcp", "otel-collector"})
| makeTimeseries lines=count(), by:{container.name}, interval:5m
6.title: Container log volume over time

7.query:
fetch logs
| filter host.name == "automation.lindleyhome.com" and container.name == "homeassistant"
| filter contains(lower(content), "error") or contains(lower(content), "exception")
| makeTimeseries errors=count(), interval:5m
7.title: HA errors over time

9.query:
fetch logs
| filter host.name == "automation.lindleyhome.com"
| filter in(container.name, {"homeassistant", "appdaemon", "zwavejs2mqtt"})
| filter contains(lower(content), "error") or contains(lower(content), "exception") or contains(lower(content), "unhealthy")
| fields timestamp, container.name, content
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 40
9.title: Recent HA / appdaemon / zwave errors
